$comment: Demo dataset (gestion-projet/innovateur/jeu-donnees-demo.md). Same schema as seed-manifest.json, profile demo: seed_e2e.py creates categories/domains/activities; seed_demo.py posts `rules` to POST /api/v1/classification-rules/rules, imports demo-import/{DRH,DAF,DSI,MINESUP} through POST /api/v1/imports, then applies trash/locks/versions and compares the database with `expected`. `corpus` and `expected` are written by backend/scripts/demo_dataset.py (seed GED_EXPORT_SEED): edit the plan in the generator, not here. expected.files: one entry per imported file (duplicates included), path relative to demo-import, status classified|needs_review|duplicate (needs_review = no rule or a tie: commit opens a classification review shown in the review screen and creates no document until it is resolved), orgUnit = classification_target_org_unit code, nulls when not classified; trashed documents keep their entry in files. Titles = file name without extension. documents/byOrgUnit: total = classified documents + open reviews, both tenants counted (MINESUP-DAAJ proves isolation).

counting.classified: documents created at commit (list, search, trash, locks, versions act on these)
counting.toReview: open classification reviews (review screen); no document until the review is resolved
